premature.rule: Flag a lift when the device weight shows a load under 40 % of the device's typical full payload (fill under 40 % where no weight exists) and no public reason explains it: scheduled lifts above the minimum frequency, and fill-triggered orders whose weight stays low. Maximum-interval, pre-closure, decommission, ad-hoc and customer-requested lifts are not flagged.

definitions.discrepant_line_share: Share of invoice lines whose amount differs from the contract-expected amount by more than one cent. A difference is not an error by itself: tariff versions, mass basis and calculator gaps also cause differences.
definitions.jobs: Jobs the operator was asked to do in the month: completed, partial, missed by operator, wasted trip.
definitions.missed_visit_share: Share of jobs recorded as missed by the operator. A site closure or access problem can be recorded the same way.
definitions.on_time_share: Share of completed lifts done within 2 h of the scheduled time. Late lifts can have causes outside the operator (blocked access, weather, customer reschedules).
definitions.ticket_lag_days_median: Median days from weighing to sharing, over shared tickets. Tickets shared after the data extraction are not visible, so the lag is a lower bound.
definitions.ticket_share: Share of completed lifts whose weighbridge ticket was shared with the customer within 7 days. Depends on the data-sharing agreement, not only on the operator.
definitions.tonnes_per_lift: Device-estimated tonnes per completed lift that has a device weight (estimate, not a weighbridge figure). Low values can come from early lifts the customer ordered.

validation.method: Kit scorer europress_data.evaluate (score_b, score_b2), validation split. FullLoad rule on the as-of view at the validation end; kit B2 rules and B4 gradient boosting as run by the kit (B4 trained on train-period labels).

scorecard_b2.note: overall = the kit's 0-100 score over all 9 Task B2 metrics; metrics we do not produce (over/undercharge %, weight bias, order-to-lift) score 0 there. overall_covered_metrics = mean over the 5 metrics we produce.
